name: Soltia
message: 「You mean to tell me... this is the power of the Demon Lord...」

name: Soltia
message: 「To think she possesses this much latent potential...!」

name: Soltia
message: 「For today, let's leave it at a mere warm-up」

name: Soltia
message: 「Look forward to the next time we meet」

name: Macaron
message: 「Maybe I went a little too easy on punishing her...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. No matter how many times she comes at us, we'll never lose」
As long as I'm with Macaron, I know we can overcome anything.
Right now, I just can't help feeling that way.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Paqy. Did you swell up from the dampness?」

name: Paqy
message: 「My body feels so heavy, it's gross...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come to think of it, me too... My coat is heavy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's hurry back and dry off... Bwah-choo!」

name: Macaron
message: 「At this rate, you might catch another cold before we even get home...」
Either way, we have no choice but to hurry home.
I really might catch a cold....
----Just as we were about ready to give up, a kind-hearted savior noticed our plight.
The owner of the bathhouse Macaron always visits called out to us as we passed by the storefront.
It was right before opening hours, and we tried turning down the offer since we felt bad about dirtying the water, though.
Seeing the sorry state we were in, the bathhouse owner graciously let us use the men's bath, which had just finished being prepared.
Which was all well and good, except....

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, yeah, maybe a little hot...」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah! Actually, I'm fine! It's just right!」
If Macaron started wandering around in a situation like this, I wouldn't know where to look....
Just the two of us in a spacious tub.
Back-to-back, soaking up to our shoulders.
Well, I'm too worked up to relax.

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey. I really think I should wait outside...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you do that, you'll catch a cold while I'm still in here, big brother.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe the women's bath is ready by now too...」

name: Macaron
message: 「It wouldn't be right to dirty any more of their bathwater, would it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You don't wanna take a bath with me...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Thought so~. We're always together, after all」
Macaron's small back presses right up against mine.
As if mirroring my flustered heart, ripples slowly spread across the water....
My chilled body gradually regains its warmth.

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, we got really lucky that the bathhouse owner is such a nice person」

name: Synn
message: 「You've always been helping out with cleaning and stuff, right? That's all thanks to you」

name: Macaron
message: 「The only reason you get to be all warm and cozy like this, big brother, is thanks to me」

name: Macaron
message: 「...And the only reason I was able to get back on my feet like this... is thanks to you, big brother」
Macaron presses her back even closer against mine.
I can feel our heartbeats overlapping, beating faster and faster.
Whose heart is pounding harder blurs together until I can't even tell.
Just staying still like this feels like it's going to make both of us dizzy from the heat.
This hot, breathless feeling, with my head completely full of Macaron.

name: Macaron
message: 「I've always looked up to a Demon Lord like Master...」

name: Macaron
message: 「And unrelated to all that, I started thinking you were really wonderful, Big Brother...」

name: Macaron
message: 「So when I think about becoming the Demon Lord I've always admired together with you, Big Brother...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can't help grinning no matter what!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I think I get that feeling」

name: Macaron
message: 「Do you think I'm creepy too, after all?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nyaaah, geez! You only ever say things like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hyaah!? Hey, don't push me down! I'm sinking, blub-blub-blub!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Being with you is fun, Big Brother」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ever since coming to the Human World, the time I've spent with you has been the most fun of all」

name: Macaron
message: 「And I think it'll probably stay that way forever from now on」

name: Synn
message: 「...I wish I'd told you about the Demon Lord stuff sooner, Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「I kept quiet the whole time because I didn't want you to hate me, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Right now, I'm just proud that I can be of help to you, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, stop splashing around in the bath」
When I turned around, there stood Macaron, without a stitch of clothing on!?

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Wait a second, big brother! A nosebleed, you've got a nosebleed!」
In the end, I wound up getting dizzy from the heat and passing out right then and there.
I ended up causing a huge amount of trouble for both the bathhouse and Macaron.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I can never be a bride anymore...」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey... don't shake me around so much...」

name: Macaron
message: 「The dryer was super comfy, wasn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Getting spun round and round like that... urp, I still feel like I'm gonna puke...」
I can't even bear to imagine it.
Well, I guess it's better than being soaked to the bone.

name: Macaron
message: 「Taking a bath made me kinda hungry」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's hurry home and get some food」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jeez, after making me worry so much...」
